members.note: FDreamExpandableAreaStyle: the header's height, its five state colours, the label, and the content area's background and padding.

A colour rather than an FSlateBrush: the content area is a procedural rect, and what an expander's frame is in this family is that rect's fill. A picture behind the content is a Native.Border around it.
One colour where UMG has a brush and a tint over it, for the reason above: there is no brush here for a second colour to multiply.
Authored open or closed; every road that CHANGES it goes through SetIsExpanded, which is what broadcasts.
Zero is no ceiling, which is what this control has always done.
In the style, because how a project's section headers are inset is a theme decision.
Named for what it pads rather than for the widget it sits on.
Fires from a click and from code alike.

A duration rather than a second function: whether an expander animates is a property of the expander, not of the caller, so every road (a click, a binding, code) gets the same open. Zero is instant, which is what every expander already authored does.
UExpandableArea has no style setter at all (its Style is EditAnywhere only); this is the family's spelling of replacing a look at runtime.
